gates.question: Spend cap for the paid non-pool scenarios (retrieval, always-on, host-lookups, kb-lookup-agent, partial). benchmarks.py has no --dry-run estimate and no --max-usd for them (only pool and freshness plan), so: no estimate. Their last records spent 0.073 (retrieval 2026-10-08) + 0.020 (always-on 2026-10-08) + 0.859 (host-lookups 2026-10-09) + 0.124 (kb-lookup-agent 2026-09-28) + 1.793 (partial 2026-09-28) = 2.87 USD. What cap does the item's spend check hold the new records to?

notes: Sizing (plan, 2026-10-12): verdict and tool-speed make no model call; freshness makes HTTP requests only (run freshness --dry-run: 102 requests at the least for --sample 2); retrieval, always-on, host-lookups, kb-lookup-agent and partial are paid with no estimate (benchmarks.py run X --dry-run exits 2 for them) and no --max-usd, so the spend cap is gate g1 (4.50 USD, 1.5x the 2.87 USD their last records spent) read after the run by check 2. Run sequential runtime: not measured here (the last records hold wall times per run). Census Haiku 5.5 dispatch and judging are not re-run: ST-zdfghdlb (SP-yojt6y7v) measured them on 2026-10-11. Checks 2 and 3 pass before the work on purpose: check 2 sums the newest records' spend (2.87 USD today, under the cap), so it bounds the new records' spend only together with checks 0 and 1, which fail until those records are written on a tree with the scenario rows; check 3 keeps report --check green.
